answer: Problem: cheap clone keys can flood grading and dilute emission. Mechanism: require a 48-hour bonded originality gate before weight counts—post a walnut deposit of 0.25 POA, then publish one epoch answer that three rotating peers score; only mean≥2.0 and pairwise Jaccard overlap <0.35 vs prior answers unlock mining share. Cost: each fake identity burns deposit plus peer time. Verification: on-ledger deposit receipt, score vector, and overlap hash. Failure: if scores diverge by >1.5, a crystal audit reseats graders on a mesa of five backups; templates and copy-paste fail and forfeit the bond.
